title: should move from gate to editor via Build manually without the extension
verifies: a valid gate URL enables the CTAs and Build manually lands on the editor without any extension probe

title: should author a valid journey via Add Step, action/navigate/value and locator commit
verifies: Add Step appends blank click steps, fields patch them, and a locator commits on Enter

title: should block Continue until the first step navigates and element steps name a locator
verifies: Continue refuses a non-navigate first step and a locator-less element step

title: should land on the extension setup checklist when recording without the extension and skip to the editor
verifies: Record without the extension shows the setup checklist, and skip reaches the editor

title: should mutate the journey list via insert-below, duplicate and delete
verifies: per-row insert/duplicate/delete actions change the journey list length correctly

title: should save the check and return to the list
verifies: a valid journey with a selected location saves via POST /synthetics and shows the new check in the list (fixme when no location)

title: should refuse duplicate and last-candidate locator deletions
verifies: duplicate and last-candidate locator operations are refused with an inline error

title: should block Continue on an uncommitted locator draft and pass after Enter
verifies: a typed-but-uncommitted locator draft blocks Continue as locatorDraftPending, then passes after Enter

title: should guard against leaving with unsaved changes
verifies: navigating away mid-edit opens the unsaved-changes dialog before leaving

title: Edit an existing check pre-fills the wizard — data-dependent: needs a seeded check via POST /api/{org}/synthetics (buildCreateBrowserTestPayload has no test-side helper yet)
verifies: edit-load path pre-fills the wizard (parked: needs a synthetics API create helper)

title: Gate → editor via Record when extension installed — requires OpenObserve Recorder extension, not present in CI (CreateBrowserTest.vue:538-545; useSyntheticsRecorder.ts:263-287)
verifies: Record with the extension installed goes straight to the editor (extension-only, parked as fixme)

title: Actual recording captures steps — requires extension startRecording ack (useSyntheticsRecorder.ts:435-473)
verifies: a real recording captures steps into the journey (extension-only, parked as fixme)

title: Replay / preview run — requires extension replay command (useSyntheticsRecorder.ts:694-784)
verifies: a replay/preview run executes (extension-only, parked as fixme)

title: Restore-then-record (record-before / record-from-failure) — requires extension + capability (BrowserJourney.vue:614-707; useSyntheticsRecorder.ts:483-600)
verifies: restore-then-record replays the prefix before recording (extension-only, parked as fixme)

title: Incognito / preflight / replay banners — require extension failure responses (BrowserJourney.vue:1252-1570; replayFailure.ts)
verifies: incognito/preflight/replay failure banners render (extension-only, parked as fixme)
